name: proof-skill
description: Sixty-six evidence-first skills for Claude that tell you whether to ship or hold: the business side (market, simulated buyers, pricing, offer, unit economics, go to market, operations) and the product side (web and mobile testing, security, privacy, performance, accessibility, SEO, AI safety), every verdict computed from verified evidence, a four-seat board that debates and votes, and a short client report with a 14-day fix kit as the result. Free, MIT.
